Slaughterhouse is a building that allows to butcher megabeasts corpses for special rewards. This usually gives three items : a trophy, an object specific to the creature and a megabeast soul, which can be used in the Megabeast Kennels to revive the beast, or to instantly train a dwarf to legendary in a combat skill. You will also get meat, boulders or metal bars, depending on the megabeast corpse type.
